integrity.proof: Analytic normalized spherical harmonic and representation-theoretic proof; finite reproducibility checks are supplementary.
integrity.validation: No independent validation or audit has been performed.

scientific_limitations: The sharp constants require normalized probability Haar measure, usual spherical area measure and spectral weights inverse to degree plus one-half.
The stability topology is negative half-order Sobolev modulo constant and linear functions, not Hausdorff distance.
No finite sampling theorem or higher-dimensional extension is asserted.
Historical priority, including possible broader unindexed transform theorems, has not been independently certified.
title: Sharp two-mode stability for rotational symmetries of planar projections
